note: Forbidden: an AES GCM nonce other than 12 octets. Red: TestRFC5282AEADNonceIsTwelveOctets asserts len(nonce)==12 and expectOneDelete; TestRFC5282AEADRefusesANonceThatIsNotTwelveOctets refuses 11 and 13. Sender side: the nonce size is fixed once in newIKEAEAD (salt+ikeIVOctets, checked by newAESGCM) and shared by SealIKEAEAD and OpenIKEAEAD, and Go's AEAD panics on a wrong-length nonce, so a sender-only length change is not reachable without reddening the receive units.
